# Evolution Mode: Venusaur can't evolve, Ivysaur L.20 needs 12 more
# levels, and Bulbasaur L.16 evolves into Ivysaur (registered silently).
# Each double click ends the mode, so it is switched on again each time.
party 3 50
party 2 20
party 1 16
> start
> menu Actions > Evolve a POKéMON
dialog information "Doubleclick a POKéMON in the Statistics window to evolve it. Once you have doubleclicked on a POKéMON, Evolution Mode will be disabled." -> OK
> choose 1
dialog information "# 003 Venusaur, L.50, XP:125000, XP to next level:7651" -> OK
dialog information "Venusaur can't evolve." -> OK
> menu Actions > Evolve a POKéMON
dialog information "Doubleclick a POKéMON in the Statistics window to evolve it. Once you have doubleclicked on a POKéMON, Evolution Mode will be disabled." -> OK
> choose 2
dialog information "# 002 Ivysaur, L.20, XP:8000, XP to next level:1261" -> OK
dialog information "Your Ivysaur needs to grow 12 more level(s) before it can evolve." -> OK
> menu Actions > Evolve a POKéMON
dialog information "Doubleclick a POKéMON in the Statistics window to evolve it. Once you have doubleclicked on a POKéMON, Evolution Mode will be disabled." -> OK
> answer yes
> choose 3
dialog information "# 001 Bulbasaur, L.16, XP:4096, XP to next level:817" -> OK
dialog confirmation "Your Bulbasaur can evolve into Ivysaur. Do you want to evolve it?" -> Yes
dialog information "Bulbasaur evolved into Ivysaur!" -> OK
> state
state battle wild=0 trainer=0 tournament=0 type=0 own=0 hp=0 enemy=0 level=0 hp=0 levels=2-100
state player badges=0 Money=0 Wins=0 Losses=0 Fights=0 Catches=0 PokeBalls=3 GreatBalls=0 UltraBalls=0 MasterBalls=0 Potions=0 SuperPotions=0 flags=
state dex 1,2,3
state party 1:3/L50/125000 2:2/L20/8000 3:2/L16/4096
> menu Actions > Evolve a POKéMON
dialog information "Doubleclick a POKéMON in the Statistics window to evolve it. Once you have doubleclicked on a POKéMON, Evolution Mode will be disabled." -> OK
> menu Actions > Evolve a POKéMON
dialog information "Evolution Mode cancelled." -> OK
> quit
exit 0
save line 412: "1" -> "2"
